d: ⭕️ MAX STREICHER S.p.A. is an international EPC contractor headquartered in Parma, Italy, with extensive experience in pipeline and plant construction across the energy sector and a growing presence in water infrastructure projects. ⭕️

We are looking for an experienced Hydraulic Project Manager to join our Hydraulics Division and lead the execution of large-scale water transmission pipeline projects, primarily in the Middle East and East Africa.
r: Manage EPC water transmission pipeline projects, including associated pumping stations, reservoirs and civil works, from mobilisation to final handover.
Oversee pipeline construction activities, ensuring compliance with budgets, schedules, contractual requirements and HSEQ standards.
Coordinate and supervise site teams, local construction partners and subcontractors, monitoring progress and performance.
Manage operational interfaces with Clients, Engineering, Procurement and other project stakeholders.
Provide technical and operational input during project preparation and tendering, particularly on construction methodologies, cost estimates and constructability.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, preferably Civil, Hydraulic or Mechanical;
Minimum 10 years of experience in water infrastructure construction, including at least 5 years in site operations;
Proven experience in water transmission pipelines and aqueduct construction, preferably on large-scale international EPC projects;
Solid project management skills, including planning, cost control, contract management and subcontractor coordination;
Fluent English; French and/or Arabic are considered an advantage;
Strong leadership and problem-solving skills, with willingness to undertake long-term international assignments.
📍 Location: International project sites, primarily in the Middle East and Africa.
